The font the overlays (the Insert menu, the FPS counter, the start-up screen) fall back to when the player's game files do
not have the game's own menu font: Libertinus, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (libertinus/OFL.txt). Unmodified and not
renamed; nx2/ui_fonts.py compiles the files' bytes into the Vulkan back end as they are.

- libertinus/: Libertinus 7.051, from https://github.com/alerque/libertinus (release v7.051, Libertinus-7.051.zip, sha256
  4d9be29b5cb380c35af8ba967abcc752ad1e07be1f738a9789c33e0dd7478c92): static/TTF/LibertinusSans-{Regular,Bold}.ttf,
  static/TTF/LibertinusSerif-Semibold.ttf, and OFL.txt.
